title: Nokturna Galeri: Objek yang Berubah
theme: Mengeksplorasi ketegangan saat sebuah kejadian misterius mengganggu rutinitas malam di sebuah galeri seni, menantang seorang penjaga keamanan untuk mengungkap kebenaran di balik bayangan.

cover.prompt: Interior view of a hushed art gallery at a tranquil hour. The elegant lift doors are gently parting on an upper level, revealing a pristine corridor extending into the distance. Gentle ambient light softly illuminates the pathway, highlighting the refined architecture and abstract shapes of art exhibits. The composition focuses on depth and serenity, with a subtle emphasis on the calm and professional atmosphere of the valuable establishment.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: A young security guard, Indra, experiences mysterious occurrences during his night shift at an art gallery. He investigates unusual sounds and a shifting sculpture, eventually uncovering that the 'disturbances' are caused by an artist secretly adding final touches to her work before an exhibition, creating an unintentional mild thriller.
